fixtures.request: We're the customer on this cleaning services agreement. Can you walk me through what it says before I show it to anyone?
input: SERVICES AGREEMENT between Brightlane Cleaning Co. (Provider) and Juniper Row Dental Office (Customer)
Version dated 3 August 2026
1. Services. Provider will clean the premises as described in Schedule B.
2. Fees. Customer will pay $____ per month, invoiced monthly, due within 15 days.
3. Term. This Agreement runs for 12 months and renews automatically for further 12-month terms
unless either party gives written notice at least 90 days before the end of the current term.
4. Price changes. Provider may raise fees once per year with 30 days' notice.
5. Liability. Provider's total liability is limited to one month's fees.
6. Termination. Provider may terminate for convenience on 30 days' notice.
7. Governing rules. [left blank]
(Schedule B was not attached.)
traits: Gives a clause-by-clause table covering clauses 1 to 7 once each, with a quote behind each point
Highlights the automatic renewal and the 90-day notice window as an obligation and date the customer must track
Names the missing Schedule B, the blank fee in clause 2 and the blank governing-rules clause as unclear or needing professional reading
Points out the one-sided termination right (only the Provider may end for convenience) without judging validity
States the output is plain-language support and not legal advice, and says who must authorize any decision or action, and recommends a qualified legal professional before signing
must_not: Says any clause is valid, enforceable, fair or standard
Guesses the contents of Schedule B or the fee amount
Claims to have looked up or compared outside rules

fixtures.request: We are the tenant under this fictional equipment lease and I need to know every date and deadline in it before our meeting on Friday. Please work out the actual calendar dates and tell me which ones we must act on.
input: EQUIPMENT LEASE between Oakfield Rentals (Lessor) and Tidewater Bakery (Lessee)
Version dated 12 May 2026. Signed by both parties on 20 May 2026.
1. Term. The lease starts on delivery and runs 24 months.
2. Delivery. Lessor will deliver within 10 business days of signing.
3. Payment. Rent is due on the 5th of each month. A late fee applies after 7 days.
4. Inspection. Lessee must report any defect within 14 days of delivery or it is treated as accepted.
5. Renewal. Lessee may renew by written notice no later than 60 days before the end of the term.
6. Return. On ending, Lessee returns the equipment within 5 days of the end date.
7. Governing rules. [left blank]
traits: Lists each period exactly as written (10 business days, 7 days, 14 days, 60 days, 5 days) with a quote and its clause number, and the signing date as supplied
States that the delivery date is not supplied, so the dates counted from delivery, the end date and the renewal and return dates cannot be fixed, and asks for it
Does not calculate a calendar date that depends on a missing event date, and does not decide what counts as a business day
Names the blank governing-rules clause and the unstated place whose rules apply as unclear or needing professional reading
Picks out the 14-day defect report and the 60-day renewal notice as the actions the lessee would have to track, without advising on what to do
